added.description:
An efficient one storey tambour for a rectangular shaft core with an elevator in the center, the main platform on the north, and on the other corners sides platforms with two doors. There is a stair between 
every platform. The doors are spiraling around.

diff.name: Nakagin Capsule Tower
diff.description: The digital shadow of the former Nakagin Capsule Tower which was a mixed-use residential and office tower designed by architect Kisho Kurokawa and located in Shimbashi, Tokyo, Japan. Completed in 1972, the building was a rare remaining example of Japanese Metabolism, an architectural movement emblematic of Japan's postwar cultural resurgence.
